FX-VEGAS-001.says: Mask 1, the box from (2, 2) to (13, 7), 32 pixels round, of mode None; Vegas as added but Segments 4: four dashes end to end, each 8 pixels long, white and whole at its start fading to nothing at its end, over the night sky and the empty half.

FX-VEGAS-002.says: As added, 32 segments: 32 dashes of 1 pixel each, a fine shimmer all round the box.

FX-VEGAS-003.says: Segments 4, Length 0.5, Even: four 4-pixel dashes spread round the box, 8 pixels apart.

FX-VEGAS-004.says: Segments 4, Length 0.5, Bunched: four 4-pixel dashes end to end round the first half of the box; the second half bare.

FX-VEGAS-005.says: FX-VEGAS-003 with Rotation 45: every dash an eighth of the way on, 4 pixels, into the gaps.

FX-VEGAS-006.says: FX-VEGAS-004 with Rotation -90: the dashes a quarter of the way back, running on past the box's first corner from its end.

FX-VEGAS-007.says: FX-VEGAS-004 with Rotation keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 360 at frame 4, linear: the train goes once round; frames 0, 1, 2 and 4, frame 4 FX-VEGAS-004's.

FX-VEGAS-008.says: Two masks, the box and a small box from (5, 4) to (9, 6), All Masks on, Segments 2, Length 0.5, Random Phase off: each box's dashes start at its own first point.

FX-VEGAS-009.says: FX-VEGAS-008 with Random Phase on, Random Seed 1: each box's dashes start somewhere of their own.

FX-VEGAS-010.says: FX-VEGAS-009 with Random Seed 2: other starts.

FX-VEGAS-011.says: FX-VEGAS-008 with Random Seed 7 and Random Phase off: the seed is unused, FX-VEGAS-008's frame.

FX-VEGAS-012.says: FX-VEGAS-001 with Blend Mode Transparent: the dashes alone, the night gone.

FX-VEGAS-013.says: FX-VEGAS-001 with Blend Mode Under: the dashes behind the layer, seen only on the empty right half.

FX-VEGAS-014.says: FX-VEGAS-001 with Blend Mode Stencil: the night only under the dashes, the colour unused.

FX-VEGAS-016.says: Segments 4, Width 3, Hardness 1: hard edges, smoothed over one pixel.

FX-VEGAS-017.says: Segments 4, Length 0.5, Even, Start Opacity 1 and End Opacity 1: whole dashes, no fade.

FX-VEGAS-018.says: Segments 4, Start Opacity 0.2, End Opacity 1, Mid-point Opacity 0.5 at Mid-point Position 0.25: faint, quickly brighter, then whole at the end.

FX-VEGAS-019.says: Segments 4, Start and End Opacity 1, Mid-point Opacity -1: each dash dips to nothing at its middle.

FX-VEGAS-020.says: Segments 4, Mid-point Position 0, Mid-point Opacity -0.4: the first line unused, each dash starting at 0.6 and fading to nothing.

FX-VEGAS-021.says: Segments 4, Mid-point Position 1, Mid-point Opacity 0.5: the first line the whole dash, from 1 down to M, 0.5, at its end; End Opacity unused.

FX-VEGAS-022.says: Length 0: nothing is drawn; the drawing, untouched.

FX-VEGAS-023.says: Width 0: nothing is drawn; the drawing, untouched.

FX-VEGAS-025.says: Segments 1, Length 0.75: one long dash three quarters of the way round, fading from the box's top-left corner.

FX-VEGAS-027.says: A curved mask, a circle 8 across about (8, 5), Segments 6, Length 0.6, Even: six dashes follow the curve.

FX-VEGAS-028.says: Two masks, Path mask 2: the small box alone, Segments 4.

FX-VEGAS-029.says: The mask's path keyed from the box at frame 0 to the box two rows lower at frame 4: the dashes follow it, frames 0, 2 and 4.

FX-VEGAS-030.says: FX-VEGAS-001 moved three pixels right: the dashes move with the drawing.

FX-VEGAS-031.says: After a Motion Tile that grows the layer: the mask is the drawing's own, so the frame is FX-VEGAS-001's.

FX-VEGAS-033.says: Width 3 and Segments keyed from 1 at frame 0 to 8 at frame 4: more, shorter dashes; frames 0, 2 and 4.
